consumption.title: House consumption
consumption.description: Without a house sensor, consumption is computed as grid import − export + solar production + battery discharge − battery charge. The daily average is only used until 7 days of history are learned.

data.grid_import_sensor: Grid import energy (if no house sensor)

data_description.efficiency: 85 % by default, then learned over 30 days from the battery energy counters.
data_description.wear: Battery price ÷ (capacity × announced cycles). 0 to ignore.
data_description.gain_threshold: A night grid charge only happens if each kWh returned earns at least this much (0.02 by default).
data_description.profile: Safety margin added to the peak-hour need: cautious 20 %, balanced 10 %, economical 0 %.

data.subscribed_kva: Subscribed power (only if missing in Tarifs Électricité)

data_description.subscribed_kva: Read from ha-tarifs-electricite when it is set there.
data_description.three_phase: The limit becomes subscribed power ÷ 3 on the battery's phase; the grid sensor must measure that phase.
data_description.margin: 10 % minimum: the regulation can exceed the limit for 2 to 5 s when a large appliance starts.

state.charge_needed: Charge needed to cover tomorrow's peak hours
state.enough_energy: The battery already holds enough energy
state.solar_covers: The sun will cover the need
state.gain_too_low: Price gap too small to be worth the losses
state.capacity_short: Battery too small: energy kept for the most expensive hours

integration_version.title: {name} too old or missing
integration_version.description: The Energy conductor needs {name} {minimum} or newer (found: {found}). Control is suspended until it is updated.

missing_entities.title: Required entities not found
missing_entities.description: These entities could not be found: {keys}. Check that they are enabled, or choose the sources again in the options. Control is suspended.

subscribed_power_missing.title: Subscribed power not set
subscribed_power_missing.description: Set it in Tarifs Électricité (Configure) or in the Power options of the Energy conductor. Without it, no charging can be planned safely.

no_solar_forecast.title: No solar forecast for 24 h
no_solar_forecast.description: None of the selected solar forecasts answered for 24 hours. Plans are computed without sun.

member_battery.title: The selected battery belongs to a Group
member_battery.description: Select the Group instead of the battery in the Sources options: a member battery is driven by its Group.

battery_degraded.title: Battery Group degraded
battery_degraded.description: At least one battery of the Group is out of the distribution. Plans continue with the others.

notify_plan_charge.message: Tonight: charging {energy} up to {soc} %, starting {start}. Estimated gain {gain}.

notify_plan_idle.message: Tonight: no charging, the battery has enough energy.

notify_plan_not_profitable.message: Tonight: no charging, the price gap does not cover the battery losses.

notify_power_alert.message: Risk of exceeding the subscribed power tonight (limit {limit}): check the large appliances.

notify_charge_unfinished.message: Tonight's charge stopped at {soc} % instead of {target} %.

force_night.name: Force tonight
force_night.description: Imposes a charge or a rest for the current night; automatic control resumes the next day.

target_soc.name: Target state of charge
target_soc.description: For a charge; maximum SOC if empty.
